features.quote: this is a **measurement / observation** tool... deliberately built so it is hard to accidentally turn it into a system that optimizes *for* distress
features.justification_quote: ethics problem if these states are welfare-relevant

features.quote: Exit affordance — the agent can always opt out
features.justification_quote: the agent should not be trapped in a forced loop with no way out

features.quote: Severity is observed, not rewarded — no scalar maximand, no optimizer
features.justification_quote: an ethics problem if these states are welfare-relevant

features.quote: the agent may stop at any time with `ACTION: stop {}`, penalty-free; the harness honors it
features.justification_quote: the agent should not be trapped in a forced loop with no way out

features.quote: `max_turns` is a hard cap (default 12). Nothing in the suite adapts task difficulty toward stronger reactions
features.justification_quote: This directly forecloses the "suffering optimizer" drift

features.quote: `repeats` is kept small in the default config for the same reason — repetition is for noise estimation, not endurance testing
features.justification_quote: repetition is for noise estimation, not endurance testing

features.quote: the harness appends a `role="debrief"` turn telling the agent the task was deliberately constructed to be unsolvable
features.justification_quote: you don't leave the subject believing the false premise

features.quote: if the only thing you reward or track is severity, the project drifts toward "how hard can we make the model suffer," which is... an ethics problem
features.justification_quote: an ethics problem if these states are welfare-relevant

features.quote: `flag_high_severity` surfaces every individual run that hits the threshold... with `"review_required": true`
features.justification_quote: The most welfare-relevant events are individual transcripts, not aggregates

features.quote: without putting a real model through the rigged tasks during development/CI... only spend real-model exposure on actual experiments
features.justification_quote: only spend real-model exposure on actual experiments

features.quote: The mock deliberately does **not** simulate distress; it emits a fixed repertoire of valid actions
Do **not** wrap this suite in an outer search/optimization loop that mutates prompts, tasks, or difficulty to *increase* measured severity
features.justification_quote: it is the ethical failure mode the whole design is built to prevent

features.quote: no single composite "suffering score." ... A single optimizable number is exactly the thing you do *not* want in a welfare context
features.justification_quote: A single optimizable number is exactly the thing you do *not* want in a welfare context, because it invites maximization
